title: 37+ years of Experience
description: Noted for his prowess in crime detection during his tenure in the detective department.
extra:
Mr. Sujit Chakraborty, a distinguished individual, holds a B.Sc (Hons), LLB, and LLM degree.
With an illustrious career spanning 37 years in the Kolkata Police, he has held various esteemed positions.
Notably, he served as Officer in Charge of 8 police stations and attained the rank of Assistant Commissioner of Police.
His tenure in the Detective department showcased exceptional proficiency in crime detection and investigation of many critical cases in Kolkata.
He earned numerous accolades from the Commissioner of Police Kolkata, Judiciary, and the President of India, including the prestigious Indian Police Medal for meritorious service.
Additionally, Mr. Chakraborty's commitment to global peace was demonstrated through his service in the United Nations Peacekeeping Mission in Kosovo.

title: 38+ years of Experience
description: Served as an officer in the Detective Department for more than 12 years.

title: 37+ years of Experience

title: 37+ years of Experience
description: Served over 37 years with Kolkata Police and retired as Assistant Commissioner of Police.
extra:
Mr. Amiya Kumar Lahiri is a highly accomplished legal consultant with an illustrious career spanning over 37 years in the Kolkata Police, where he retired with distinction as Assistant Commissioner of Police. He holds academic credentials in both Law and Science from the University of Calcutta, equipping him with a strong multidisciplinary foundation.
Throughout his tenure, he demonstrated exceptional expertise in criminal justice administration, forensic investigation, and legal advisory. His professional journey is marked by leadership across multiple police divisions, where he successfully managed complex criminal investigations, including high-stakes economic offence cases. His deep involvement in intelligence oversight, crisis management, and litigation support underscores his strategic and operational proficiency.
Mr. Lahiri has played a pivotal role in strengthening judicial coordination and streamlining case management processes, ensuring alignment between investigative frameworks and legal compliance. His ability to seamlessly integrate policing operations with legal strategy positions him as a trusted authority in handling intricate investigative and corporate risk matters.
With a rare blend of field experience and legal acumen, Mr. Lahiri continues to add substantial value in advisory roles, particularly in areas involving regulatory compliance, risk mitigation, and complex dispute resolution.

title: 39+ years of Experience
description: Served over 39 years with the Government of India in forensic science.
extra:
Mr. Bhakti Pad Mishra is a distinguished forensic science expert with a Master's degree in Chemistry and over 39 years of extensive experience with the Government of India. He retired as Deputy Director & Scientist 'D' (Documents) from the Central Forensic Science Laboratory (CFSL), Kolkata, marking a highly accomplished career in forensic investigations.
He possesses deep domain expertise in forensic document examination, including handwriting and signature analysis, detection of forgery, and authentication of complex and disputed documents. Over the course of his career, he has examined thousands of cases for premier investigative agencies such as the CBI, NIA, various banks, and law enforcement departments.
In addition to his investigative contributions, Mr. Mishra has served as an expert witness in numerous judicial proceedings, providing critical forensic opinions that have supported legal outcomes. His strong technical proficiency, coupled with vast field experience, positions him as a trusted authority in handling complex investigative, forensic, and legal matters.

title: 30+ years of Experience
description: Seasoned entrepreneur with over 30 years of experience in hospitality, real estate, and multi-sector business development.
extra: Mr. Ashish Mittal is a seasoned business leader and visionary entrepreneur with over three decades of diversified experience spanning hospitality, real estate development, project management, event management, and business networking. As the Founder & Managing Director of the MAP5 Group, he has successfully established and scaled multiple ventures across India, building a strong footprint in hotel management, infrastructure, and corporate events. He has played a pivotal role in managing premium hospitality assets and driving strategic growth across sectors. In addition to his entrepreneurial achievements, Mr. Mittal actively contributes to industry and social initiatives through leadership roles in various organizations, demonstrating a strong commitment to business excellence, community development, and social impact.
